evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: Market-level last_update is the last time The Odds API's system saw odds for that market from the bookmaker (a provider-observed timestamp for the bookmaker market state, not a bookmaker-originated timestamp). The historical snapshot 'timestamp' is the state time of the snapshot.
evidence_items.excerpt: The market-level last_update field shows the last time our system saw odds for that market from the bookmaker.
evidence_items.notes: Provider-observed source state satisfies the LBSQ-001 source-observed definition; it is not claimed to originate at the bookmaker (preserves DEC-020).

evidence_items.excerpt: Historical odds data is available from June 6th 2020.
evidence_items.notes: Technical availability of historical data; retention rights are a separate question.
